online learning options that meet your unique needs.

For more than 25 years, Bellevue University has been a leader in online learning—offering flexible, fully online programs designed for working adults, military personnel, and lifelong learners. With over 80 online bachelor’s, master’s, and associate degree options, advancing your education and career has never been more accessible or achievable—no matter where life takes you.

FAQs

Bellevue University’s online programs make it easier to balance education with your busy life. Small, interactive classes and dedicated faculty ensure a rich, engaging learning experience that’s every bit as rewarding as being in the classroom.

Interaction is built into our Anytime Online* courses in a variety of ways including discussion forums, online collaboration and peer review. Our secure and easily accessible Blackboard Online Classroom allows you to:

  • Attend class for assignments and lectures on your own schedule
  • Meet and interact with fellow students
  • Discuss lessons with instructors
  • Complete and submit assignments to your professor electronically
  • Conduct research at the online library
  • Receive support from services like the Writing Center and the Tutoring and Study Skills Center

As an active enrolled student you will login into our secure Blackboard online classroom and see a list of the courses you are registered for. Simply by selecting or clicking the course name you will enter your Anytime Online (asynchronous), or online virtual classroom. The course contains all the lessons, assignments, links to any live sessions and discussion boards provided by your instructor. For an Anytime Online course, you set your own schedule — during the day, at night — whenever it fits into your busy life.

Each week, you find the time that is most convenient for you to get your work completed on time for that week. While there are set start and end dates for each class and regular coursework due dates within each class, there are no regularly scheduled class times, so you have the most flexibility to fit school into your life.

For online courses that are at a set time (synchronous), classes are scheduled with live class instruction in a virtual, online setting called Connected Campus. Students and instructors join from various locations. Live attendance is required. You will complete assignments for the week outside of class time at a time most convenient for you.

Classes and programs start on an ongoing basis. We offer open enrollment and most programs have several start points throughout the year. For more information, please visit with a Bellevue University Admissions Counselor.

How long to complete an online Bachelor’s degree:

Bellevue University undergraduate degree programs offer both breadth and depth in academic study. Associate and bachelor’s degrees are both classified as undergraduate degrees. On average, students complete an associate degree in 2.5 years and a bachelor’s degree in 2.6 years, based on data from academic years 2022, 2023, and 2024. Individual completion times will vary depending on the academic program, number of transfer credits, academic course load taken and passed per term, the number of academic terms pursued per year, and any breaks in participation taken.

How long to complete an online Master’s degree:

Graduate degrees at Bellevue University provide advanced study in a range of fields. On average, students complete a graduate degree in 2.4 years, based on data from academic years 2022, 2023, and 2024. Individual completion times will vary depending on the academic program, the number of transfer credits, academic course load taken and passed per term, the number of academic terms pursued per year, and any breaks in participation taken.

Our faculty, dedicated support teams, and staff are committed to help you succeed. Our Blackboard online classroom system has student communication options for peers to share and exchange ideas. Other academic resources include free peer tutoring, Writing Center, the Freeman/Lozier library collection of resources, and library staff support.

Bellevue University’s approach to exceptional online learning starts at the top, with our faculty. All of our online instructors participate in a rigorous 6-week training program for online course delivery techniques. Our faculty actually experience online learning so they can better understand you, the student’s, point of view, learning first-hand what works and what doesn’t work.

We know that online learning requires much more than dry, static presentations that have been hastily converted to fit an online course. Faculty employ a variety of multimedia tools to present demonstrations and lessons. You will not only read about concepts – you will see how they are applied.

Bellevue does offer certain degrees in which you may take online courses, either asynchronous “Anytime Online”, or synchronous online courses (offered at a set time) in a hybrid version called Connected Campus. Our student coach/advisors can work with you to find courses that meet your needs.

There is no requirement to take classes on campus. Online classes count toward residency requirement. Certain degrees may not offer all courses online so be sure to check the Curriculum pages for the degree you are pursuing. Also, see the list of our Satellite campus locations.
